items.title: AMD (AMD) Stock Gets Fair Value Boost As Analysts Rework AI Growth Expectations
items.summary: Price targets on Advanced Micro Devices have shifted into a much wider range, with recent updates running from about US$450 up to US$1,250 as analysts revisit their assumptions. Those higher and lower targets reflect very different views on how AI infrastructure demand, data center products, and new partnerships might be reflected in AMD’s valuation over time. In the sections that follow, you will see how to interpret these moves and track the evolving story around AMD with more...
